P("**Inconsistency — reinvestment period.** Section 2.05(b)(i) requires prepayment of 100% of Net Cash Proceeds of Dispositions (other than under 7.05(a)–(c)) within 5 Business Days of receipt, unless reinvested (or committed to be reinvested) within **one hundred eighty (180) days**; insurance/condemnation proceeds above $5,000,000 per fiscal year follow the same reinvestment terms (Section 2.05(b)(iv)).
